household_profile.notes: Fictional sample household for demonstration only. Replace every field with your own private data in your private repo.

bug_out_destinations.name: Primary fallback location
bug_out_destinations.notes: Primary fallback location with access considerations.

threats.name: wildfire
threats.impact: Fast evacuation risk during dry windy periods.
threats.notes: Monitor air quality and pre-evacuation warnings.

threats.name: grid_failure
threats.notes: Layered battery and generator backup required.

threats.name: water_supply
threats.impact: Short-term service interruption possible after infrastructure issues.
threats.notes: Stored water and filtration cover initial gaps.

threats.name: pandemic
threats.impact: Extended supply-chain disruption and school/work changes.
threats.notes: Requires medicine rotation and isolation planning.

threats.name: civil_unrest
threats.impact: Traffic disruption and temporary access constraints.
threats.notes: Avoidance and shelter-in-place are usually preferred.

threats.name: earthquake
threats.impact: Lower likelihood but still included in planning baseline.
threats.notes: Secure shelving and keep shoes and flashlights near beds.

solar.notes: Portable panel plus battery station for communications and refrigeration support.

communications.comms_plan: Text first, voice second, radio third. Check in at the top of each hour during active incidents.

vehicle_readiness.maintenance_status: kept above half tank and serviced on schedule

shelter_in_place.water_storage_plan: Stored in stackable containers plus sealed cases; rotate every 6 months.
shelter_in_place.power_backup: Battery station for essentials first, generator for refrigeration and climate control as needed.

medical.first_aid_capability: Standard first aid, CPR-trained adult, compact trauma kit.

skills.fire: comfortable with extinguisher use and basic fire response
skills.navigation: can navigate with offline maps and paper atlas
skills.self_defense: basic home-defense plan, no formal training

community.mutual_aid: Informal local alert group for storms and outages.
